description: This is a Java source test file containing integration tests for MQTT command and control functionalities within the Eclipse Hono framework. It tests message sending, subscription, and error handling related to MQTT command topics for devices and gateways, using a parameterized testing approach with various endpoint configurations.

classes.name: CommandAndControlMqttIT
classes.description: Integration test class for MQTT command handling in Eclipse Hono, extending MqttTestBase to provide specific MQTT command tests.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixture variables before each test, setting up tenant and device IDs.

methods.name: createConsumer
methods.description: Creates a message consumer for events with a provided message handler.

methods.name: subscribeToCommands
methods.description: Subscribes to MQTT command topics with specified handler and QoS, completing a future upon success.

methods.name: testSendOneWayCommandSucceeds
methods.description: Tests that one-way commands are successfully sent and received over MQTT.

methods.name: testSendCommandSucceedsWithQos0
methods.description: Tests command sending with QoS 0, verifying success.

methods.name: testSendCommandSucceedsWithQos1
methods.description: Tests command sending with QoS 1, verifying success.

methods.name: testSendCommandFailsForMalformedMessage
methods.description: Ensures that malformed command messages are rejected appropriately.
